name: Language server files
responsibility: Reads and writes the language servers that a checkout's committed .archboard/language-servers.json and the global language-servers.json name. The repository file wins for each language.
description: TASK-599 and ADR 0046. A repository names its servers in a file that it commits, so every machine and CI run that has the checkout runs the same ones, with no trust step. The global file sits beside the registry and fills each language that the repository file leaves out. A relative command in the repository file is a path from the checkout root, so a repository can commit a wrapper script. A file that cannot be read decides every language that it could name. A write keeps the languages in a fixed order and deletes a file that names no server.
